svg.title: Compare Retained Yield on a Common Spend Denominator
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-retained-yield-by-commercial-rail; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Retained Yield on a Common Spend Denominator; subtitle: Five illustrative commercial rails measured against $100,000 of eligible annual client spend.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are modeled retained revenue dollars, not published vendor rates or profit margins. Use comparable annual scope and exclude taxes. Rails are alternatives unless executed agreements expressly permit combined compensation without duplicate billing.; caption: The spend denominator belongs to the customer. At a modeled 8% retained yield, $6,250,000 of eligible spend would produce $500,000 operator revenue; it would not create $6,250,000 of operator revenue.; stages: label: Microsoft CSP retained spread; value: $8,000 retained from $100,000 eligible spend; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Assume an 8% retained spread after upstream shares. Confirm current CSP economics and NCE commitment exposure; CPOR attribution alone does not establish a resale discount.; label: Adobe VIP Marketplace spread; value: $10,000 retained from $100,000 eligible spend; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Assume a 10% retained spread under an authorized reseller arrangement. Validate customer eligibility, volume brackets, term alignment, and distributor deductions before quoting.; label: Zoom or UCaaS residual; value: $6,000 retained from $100,000 eligible spend; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Assume a 6% annual retained residual after master-agent shares. Reconcile Telarus or Avant statements and account for installation delays, cancellations, and contracted chargebacks.; label: Private GPO administrative rebate; value: $4,000 retained from $100,000 eligible spend; numeric value: 4000.0; detail: Assume a 4% earned administrative rebate after member allocations. Confirm the purchasing bracket, qualifying spend, payment timing, and which party owns each rebate component.; label: Renewal shared-savings fee; value: $6,000 retained from $20,000 verified savings; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Reduce a comparable $100,000 baseline to $80,000 and earn 30% of the $20,000 verified reduction. The contracted 25%–35% fee range would produce $5,000–$7,000.

text.title: Compare Retained Yield on a Common Spend Denominator
text.tspan: Compare Retained Yield on a Common Spend Denominator

rect.title: label: Microsoft CSP retained spread; value: $8,000 retained from $100,000 eligible spend; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Assume an 8% retained spread after upstream shares. Confirm current CSP economics and NCE commitment exposure; CPOR attribution alone does not establish a resale discount.

label: Adobe VIP Marketplace spread; value: $10,000 retained from $100,000 eligible spend; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Assume a 10% retained spread under an authorized reseller arrangement. Validate customer eligibility, volume brackets, term alignment, and distributor deductions before quoting.

label: Zoom or UCaaS residual; value: $6,000 retained from $100,000 eligible spend; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Assume a 6% annual retained residual after master-agent shares. Reconcile Telarus or Avant statements and account for installation delays, cancellations, and contracted chargebacks.

label: Private GPO administrative rebate; value: $4,000 retained from $100,000 eligible spend; numeric value: 4000.0; detail: Assume a 4% earned administrative rebate after member allocations. Confirm the purchasing bracket, qualifying spend, payment timing, and which party owns each rebate component.

label: Renewal shared-savings fee; value: $6,000 retained from $20,000 verified savings; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Reduce a comparable $100,000 baseline to $80,000 and earn 30% of the $20,000 verified reduction. The contracted 25%–35% fee range would produce $5,000–$7,000.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are modeled retained revenue dollars, not published vendor rates or profit margins. Use comparable annual scope and exclude taxes. Rails are alternatives unless executed agreements expressly permit combined compensation without duplicate billing.
